# voronoi_on_atoms { #mofography.analyze.voronoi_on_atoms }

```python
analyze.voronoi_on_atoms(ase_atoms, points=None)
```

It takes an ASE atoms object and returns a freud Voronoi object

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type   | Description               | Default    |
|-----------|--------|---------------------------|------------|
| ase_atoms |        | the atoms object from ASE | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description        |
|--------|--------|--------------------|
|        |        | The Voronoi object |
